description: This file extends the 'OnboardingView' class with various async methods for permission handling, monitoring updates, CLI installation, and local gateway probing, specific to the app's onboarding and device discovery functionalities.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: An extension of the OnboardingView class providing various asynchronous permission and monitoring operations.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes permissions by invoking permissionMonitor's refreshNow method.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability; manages isRequesting state and refreshes permissions after ensuring the capability.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Updates monitoring state for permissions based on the current page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Manages discovery monitoring based on the page index, starts or stops gateway discovery, and delays start if necessary.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Updates both permission and discovery monitoring states and potentially triggers onboarding chat.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Async method to install CLI tools if not already installed, updating the CLI status.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Updates CLI installation location and status indicators.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the local gateway port and updates the localGatewayProbe with command info and expected tokens.
